notes.title: Spare Teeth is Launching Dec. 12 2019!
notes.content: Finally, after many months of development, Spare Teeth is finally emerging from its cocoon and emerging into the wild world of fully released games. There has been a ton of improvements, and by now, we would say it's about time! We hope you guys give it a go and immerse yourself in the land of Anesthesia! Thursday, December 12th, we will be launching the full-release of Spare Teeth VR and placing it at a 40% off launch discount. So grab it for the holidays!

notes.title: Full Release Imminent
notes.content:
We are wrapping up the development of the full release of Spare Teeth. All that is left for us to do is to connect the achievements to Steam and allow them to unlock some in-game goodies. We have made some significant improvements to the level system, as well as several design upgrades that really push the world of King Tooth's expansive realm. 

We re-worked the bowling ball release system to fit the theme of the game and adjusted and tested (and tested, and tested) to be sure it worked for both right-handed and left-handed users. There have been months of on and off again changes and tweaks to things in almost every facet of the game. We are so close, and it feels like it has been at the brink for some time now, but without the Steam integrations, we could not release it with clean conscience.

We are nearly there, so hang on, because sometime this month, we will push the game into its full release! 

Oh, and I can't forget: We just started up a discord server for those of you that want to come hang out there! [url=https://discord.gg/gQYpVpj]Spare Teeth Discord[/url]

Go bowl, or golf, or whatever you want to call it and achieve greatness and let your friends know that King Tooth is proud of your service.
